nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes versus model training data, so agents must read the bundled docs before writing code. The block is regenerated by `next dev` (generate-agent-files.js), so deleting it from a diff only recreates an uncommitted change - commit it with the work instead.

nodes.label: Bundled Next.js Docs as Authority
nodes.rationale: `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` is resolved from the file's directory rather than the repo root because in monorepos the `next` package may not be visible from the root.
